cohort: The study included 180 premature neonates born before 28 weeks' gestation between 1999 and 2014 who suffered from intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH).
finding: Thrombocytopenia was significantly higher in patients who did not develop post-hemorrhagic hydrocephalus (PHH) after intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH), suggesting it may play a decisive role in avoiding PHH.
